xwikidoc.content: {{include reference="XWiki.LiveTableResultsMacros" /}} {{velocity wiki="false"}} ## Same results as XWiki.LiveTableResults, except that the CVE identifier is displayed as a link to its CVE record. ## Advisories without CVE identifier keep the default empty value, instead of a link without target. ## Once disclosed, an advisory is published on a new page, and the original page holds a redirect to it: the original ## pages are skipped so that each advisory is listed once. #if ($xcontext.action == 'get' and "$!request.outputSyntax" == 'plain') #set ($map = {}) #set ($skipPublishedOriginals = "and not exists (select redirectObj.id from BaseObject redirectObj where redirectObj.name = doc.fullName and redirectObj.className = 'XWiki.RedirectClass')") #gridresultwithfilter_buildJSON("$!request.classname" $request.collist.split(',') '' $skipPublishedOriginals {} $map) #foreach ($row in $map.rows) #if ("$!row.cveId_value" != '') #set ($cveURL = "https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=$escapetool.url($row.cveId_value)") #set ($cveLink = "$escapetool.xml($row.cveId_value)") #set ($discard = $row.put('cveId', $cveLink)) #end #end #jsonResponse($map) #end {{/velocity}}
